method_limits: the source leg looks for the last dotted component of the name the evidence row carries; a line that spells the same name differently (getattr, a loop variable) is published as contradicted rather than resolved
a literal-hows row is checked by its last family component, not by the whole path, so a line that names the tail but builds a different head still reads confirmed

the reader leg counts class literals in .py files outside results/ and data/, and calls a line a branch when it carries a comparison or conditional token; it does not type-check which value is compared
the face is read as published on disk at its own cutoff; nothing is rebuilt upstream and nothing is executed but this measurement
